description: This file defines a minimal configuration provider for autocomplete features, replacing a more complex ConfigHandler system with hardcoded defaults. It includes interfaces for configuration and profile, default configuration constants, and a class that provides methods to load and access configuration settings, primarily for use in autocomplete/NextEdit contexts.

classes.name: MinimalConfigProvider
classes.description: A class that provides a minimal, hardcoded configuration for autocomplete features, with methods to load and retrieve configuration options, and stub methods for reloading and updating configuration.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Asynchronously returns the current configuration in a shape compatible with ConfigHandler.loadConfig().

methods.name: getAutocompleteOptions
methods.description: Returns the current autocomplete options from the configuration.

methods.name: isStaticContextualizationEnabled
methods.description: Checks if static contextualization is enabled in the configuration.

methods.name: reloadConfig
methods.description: Stub method for reloading configuration, does nothing in this minimal implementation.

methods.name: onConfigUpdate
methods.description: Stub method to register a configuration update handler, does nothing in this minimal implementation.

methods.name: registerCustomContextProvider
methods.description: Stub method to register a custom context provider, does nothing in this minimal implementation.
